items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Fernando Arbello was added... [INTERVIEWEE] Charles Linton, that's the singer.

ctx.x: This is December 1933. And then in 1934, Bobby Stark came in, and then Fernando Arbello was added and Waymon Carver was added and Charles Linton.
